page.layout: One printed page of text, set in a single column with verse stanzas, centred headings and dates. No marginal notes. Faint show-through from the facing page on the right is ignored.

main_text.p: Præterijsse uelim quicquam curæq;, laborisq; At mihi cùm donis longè superata facultas Deficiat: precor ipse Deum, semperq; precabor, Hoc placidè longum cunctos ut seruet in æuum.
Rerum Creatori, Deo patri, filio, & spiritui sancto, sit laus & gloria, virtus atque maiestas in omne æuum: Amen.
main_text.head: Vaticinium Ioannis Regiomontani, de interitu mundi.
main_text.p: Post mille expletos à partu virginis annos, Et post quingentos rursus ab orbe datos. Octogesimus octauus mirabilis annus Ingruet: is secum tristia fata trahet. Si non hoc anno totus malus occidet orbis, Si non in nihilum terra fretumq; ruant: Cuncta tamen mundi sursum ibunt atq; deorsum Imperia: & luctus undiq; grandis erit.
main_text.head: De instabilitate rerum huius mundi.
main_text.p: Omnia sunt mundi, quasi bulla caduca rotundi: In pratis ut flos, sic perit omnis honos. Corpora putrescunt hominũ, post funera crescunt Serpentes: uitam quare homo cerne tuam.

page.notes: The catchword "Temporis" is set at the right below the last line. The running head "December." is taken from the top of the page. Stanza lines are run together within each paragraph. The ꝯ-type abbreviation marks are rendered as printed with q;.
